insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Variant 2023: capped at Shared Room; 20% co-payment if higher room chosen. Variant 2022 appears to have no room cap. Pro-rata applies to associated medical expenses if higher room taken.

icu.note: No separate ICU sub-limit mentioned in the policy wording.

copayment.display: 20% if higher room than Shared Room (Variant 2023 only)
copayment.note: Applies only under Variant 2023 when insured opts for a room category above Shared Room. No mandatory co-pay otherwise.

sub_limits.note: Vaccination for animal bite capped at ₹5,000. Road ambulance ₹2,000/hospitalisation, air ambulance ₹2,50,000. NCB sub-limits do not increase. No disease-wise sub-limits found beyond these.

deductible.note: Annual Aggregate Deductible is an optional cost-sharing feature; no mandatory deductible in base plan.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents covered from day 1.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases excluded for 36 months from first policy inception. Reducible via portability credits.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, fibroids, etc.) excluded for 24 months. Accidents covered from day 1; cancer after 30-day wait.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 20% of base SI added per claim-free year; maximum 100%. Sub-limits do not increase with NCB.

restoration.note: Refill benefit adds an amount equal to base SI once per policy year after first claim is paid (even partial utilisation). Applies for any illness (same or different).

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge for the same condition.

day_care.note: Procedures requiring less than 24 hours due to technological advancement are covered; minimum 2-hour admission required.

domiciliary.note: Home Care/Domiciliary Treatment covered when doctor advises home treatment with continuous active monitoring. Pre & post hospitalisation benefit also applies.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered in recognised AYUSH hospitals with minimum 24-hour admission. India only.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses of donor covered when insured undergoes transplant. Also covers insured's own organ donation expenses.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance ₹2,000 per hospitalisation; air ambulance ₹2,50,000 for emergency only. Registered ambulance mandatory. Payable only when hospitalisation claim is paid.

modern_treatments.note: Covers robotic surgeries, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, HIFU, balloon sinuplasty, stereotactic radio surgery, deep brain stimulation, intravitreal injections, bronchial thermoplasty, IONM, vaporisation of prostate.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical consumables (gloves, masks, etc.) explicitly excluded in Annexure I.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatments in India only; expenses outside India explicitly excluded.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration credits), no claim can be contested except for established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30-day grace period for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment. Coverage available during grace period only if premium paid in instalments.

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies only, not on renewals. Pro-rata premium refunded if no claim made.

portability.note: IRDAI-mandated portability; credits for PED waiting, specific waiting periods, NCB and moratorium transferable to new insurer.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, OPD treatment, infertility/IVF, external congenital anomaly, dental (non-accident), refractive error <7.5D, personal waiting period up to 48mo, self-inflicted injury

optional_riders.display: Hospital Cash (daily benefit up to 30 days), Personal Accident (AD + PTD + PPD), Annual Aggregate Deductible
